newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Development Bank signs US$50 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Development Bank signs US$50 mln FRCD.

text.p: Guangdong Development Bank has signed a US$50 million floating-rate certificate of deposit (FRCD) issue with 16 financial institutions, the arrangers said.
The issue was over-subscribed, but not increased, they said.
The three-year FRCDs, which were launched through the bank's Macau branch, were priced at par to float at 45 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
There is a call option on the second anniversary. With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 61 basis points.

Arrangers, with US$5 million each, are HSBC Markets, Standard Chartered Bank and Westdeutsche Landesbank's Hong Kong branch. Co-arrangers and lead managers are Bayerische Vereinsbank's Hong Kong branch and Berliner Bank, with US$4 million each, and Korea Development Bank, Merrill Lynch International, Sakura Finance Asia and Sudwestdeutsche Landesbank's Singapore branch, with US$3 million each.

Co-lead managers are Gulf International Bank, with US$3 million, and CARIPLO's Hong Kong branch, Landesbank Rheinland-Pfalz and Merita Bank's Singapore branch, with US$2 million each. Managers, with US$2 million each, are Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena Singapore branch, Banca Nazionale del Lavoro Hong Kong branch and Credito Italiano Hong Kong branch.
